outline.subject: Orchard Supply Hardware was an American retailer of home improvement and gardening products.

sections.title: Orchard Supply Hardware
sections.covers: This section provides an overview of the company's history as a retailer, its corporate ownership changes, and its eventual closure and brand acquisition.

sections.title: History
sections.covers: This section details the origins of the company as a cooperative, its growth into a retail chain, and the eventual closure of its stores.

sections.title: Mergers and acquisitions
sections.covers: This section outlines the various corporate ownership changes, financial investments, and debt issues that impacted the company.

sections.title: Expansion
sections.covers: This section describes the company's efforts to grow its retail footprint into new geographic regions and urban markets.

sections.title: Reorganization
sections.covers: This section explains the company's bankruptcy filing, the sale of its assets to a larger home improvement chain, and the subsequent store closures.

sections.title: Technology
sections.covers: This section discusses the pilot program that introduced robotic assistants to help customers locate items within the stores.

sections.title: Boxcar
sections.covers: This section describes the history of a railroad boxcar used for advertising and its eventual donation to a historical organization.

sections.title: Calendars
sections.covers: This section details the company's long-running marketing program featuring commissioned artwork, primarily focused on railroad themes.
